race.description: Dubbo City & Gilgandra Toyota 'Big Dance Eligibility' Dubbo Gold Cup
race.comment: PUNTIN (6) at his top for this and looks to get plenty of favours with the 54.5kg. Nailed late by Silvanito when second over 1500m at Rosehill. Top three player. SPICY LU (4) stakes placed mare who needed the run first up with a plugging seventh over 1400m at Randwick. Gets out to her right trip and can stalk the solid tempo. Each way contender.  TOM VEGAS (14) can surprise in this company after savaging the line with a narrow second over 1300m in the Panorama at Bathurst. Ready for this trip and stays in the calculations. STAY SILENT (2) comes up from Victoria in good order. Blinkers go on and gets Stiff's claim.
